skill_short_description: Meta-skill for the eDNA occurrence pipeline: (1) cross-check eDNA ASV observations against GBIF/OBIS/WoRMS/FishBase + Bio-ORACLE/WorldClim environmental envelopes (realm-aware: marine/freshwater/terrestrial); (2) publication-ready occurrence figures (maps, profiles, envelopes, trait space); (3) publish validated observations as DwC-A to GBIF/IPT and OBIS (Event Core + DNA-derived data). Router — routes to the three phase sub-skills: crosscheck/, viz/, publish/. Use when asked to 'cross-check eDNA results', 'plot species occurrence', or 'publish eDNA to GBIF/OBIS'.
